database_limit: Commander Spellbook is incomplete, especially for new cards. No-match records are evidence, not proof of absence.
notes: The six unchanged records retain 2026-08-30 full-list Commander Spellbook scans plus manual prerequisite review. Aragorn, Frodo and Sam, Gandalf, and the changed Minn list were manually reviewed against the exact 2026-09-01 audit; their full-list Spellbook records remain explicitly marked needs-refresh because no revised list was uploaded without separate authorization.

decks.summary: Annie Joins Up and Roaming Throne can multiply Aragorn triggers, and Jeskai Ascendancy repeatedly untaps Bloom Tender, Faeburrow Elder, and the other mana creatures. The exact list has no repeatable spell, buyback engine, or creature recast loop to turn those engines into a deterministic cycle; all current multicolor-spell and token sequences are finite.

The exact-list scan returned no included combo. Manual review found no loop among Selvala, Devoted Druid, Pip-Boy 3000, Bear Umbra, or the Equipment-copy package; the deck's sharp finishes remain finite commander-damage attacks.

decks.summary: Gandalf can cast a free spell at the beginning of every combat, so World at War and Savage Beating create additional commander triggers and explosive finite chains. Neither spell can recur itself, the list has no repeatable extra-combat recursion, and the Wizard trigger-copy package only multiplies bounded triggers; no current deterministic loop was found.

Commander Spellbook returned the Mikaeus and Viscera Seer template, but the exact list has no qualifying persist creature. Manual review of the death, blitz, and reanimation package found no replacement that closes the loop.

decks.review_basis: manual exact-list Oracle and prerequisite review; Commander Spellbook full-list refresh remains pending
decks.summary: The refreshed list still has Ashnod's Altar, Phyrexian Altar, and Blasting Station, but no effect that returns a sacrificed Illusion or recreates a token from the sacrifice itself. Draw doublers increase Minn triggers while Teferi's ultimate is a distant two-extra-turn finisher; the current 100 has no complete sacrifice, draw, or extra-turn loop.

All three returned Apex Altisaur and Wrathful Raptors lines are present. They clear opposing creatures and can deal near-infinite damage when opposing bodies keep Apex Altisaur's fight chain going; Savage Order is the compact tutored version and is the list's main Bracket 3 disclosure.

Commander Spellbook returned the finite Fire Covenant and Brash Taunter kill. Manual review also found a real but expensive five-card Arcbond loop: copy Arcbond onto Selfless Squire, make both it and Brash Taunter indestructible, then have Brash fight the Squire. The two delayed triggers feed each other while the Squire prevents damage to you.

lines.reason: Copy Arcbond so Brash Taunter and Selfless Squire each have its delayed trigger, give both indestructible, and activate Brash Taunter to fight the Squire. Each Arcbond trigger damages the other creature and creates the next trigger; Selfless Squire prevents the damage to you while opponents take every iteration.
